Subject: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 qualification — Elara Health (post-call recap)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for your time today — quick recap and next steps from our call so your security and procurement teams have a concise thread to reference. Happy to sync with any additional stakeholders you loop in.

Recap of requirements you outlined:
- Use case: clinical decision support and patient messaging; will process PHI (e.g., patient names, notes).
- Compliance needs: BAA required; SOC 2 Type II evidence; detailed audit logs for model inputs/outputs; retention policy controls; encryption of data at rest and in transit.
- Data residency: US only.
- Security review cadence: quarterly reviews and ability to support audits (evidence package / access to logs).
- Timeline: pilot in Q3, production by end of year (subject to procurement).

Deployment mode considerations we discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to launch but typically not allowed for PHI unless covered by a BAA and SOC2 + additional contractual controls — often customers prefer Dedicated or Private for PHI.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools, data isolation, and SLA — good middle ground if you need predictable throughput and lower ops overhead. We can offer subnet-level isolation and enhanced logging.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full customer-managed networking and stronger controls for highly regulated workflows (recommended if your security team requires no multi-tenant surface).

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I will share our SOC 2 Type II report, a BAA template, and a short network-architecture sketch for the Private VPC flow so your security team can review.
2) If your security team prefers, we can schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with Solutions Engineering to walk through architecture, logging/audit capabilities, and key controls.
3) Marissa/Neha from my team will provide an initial cost/ops estimate for Dedicated vs Private options (pilot vs production).

Ask for you: can you confirm the following so we can tailor the materials?
- Primary security contact (name + email) for evidence exchange and any dependency questionnaires (e.g., SCCM / vendor risk).
- Any minimum retention windows or specific log export requirements for audits.

I attached our standard SOC 2 report and a BAA template for initial review — will follow up with the network diagram and cost estimate.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 qualification — Elara Health (post-call recap)

Thanks Dylan — very helpful recap. A few clarifications from our end: we are a covered entity and will absolutely need a signed BAA. SOC 2 Type II evidence is required, and our security team will want to validate controls around logging, key management, and access processes. Specific notes:

- We treat any clinical text as PHI — our compliance team prefers Private VPC or on-prem when possible; Dedicated could work if you can guarantee no cross-customer data access and provide detailed SOC2/controls evidence.
- Must support customer-managed encryption keys (KMS/HSM) for production.
- Auditability: we need historical access logs for 12 months and an export mechanism for audit reviews.
- Pen tests and vulnerability scan evidence should be available on request.

Can you provide the SOC 2 report (thanks for sending), the BAA template (thanks), and also a short network-architecture diagram for the Private VPC flow (showing who manages routing, where logs land, and how KMS is integrated)?

Budget note: we have a preference for Private but it depends on cost and timeline. Please include a ballpark for a 3-month pilot (limited scope) for both Dedicated and Private options.

Finally, put me in touch with whoever will be our security lead at Redwood for the evidence exchange.

Best,
Sarah Thompson
Head of Security & Compliance
Elara Health
